title: Complete cultivation-path dossier: later ascension progress and local design/source limits
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete cultivation dossier, later retired-prototype and partial ascension delivery history, scoped canon/guide/image evidence
reviews.disposition:
Complete review covers all647 input lines: seven sampled works/eighteen families, lifecycle/retention matrices, five proposed loops, innate-capacity/root addendum, heat-retaining trait and ward examples, compatibility/wishlist/self-review, all seven DR image descriptions, canon comparison and ASC1–ASC46 across the three later rounds. The source passages, Discord images, private summaries and code were not newly opened; their historical evidence states remain distinct.

**Later status corrects the opening.** The initial ordinary-manual expedition and retained Jade Hollow are September30 recommendations, not the current queue. October22 explicitly retires Jade Hollow and records Mistglass as a bounded consumer; later rounds report an ascension evaluator, partial LOTM integration and release of the old W1–W4 reservation. “UI unblocked” is not “UI delivered”, and a source/tested evaluator is not a full native ladder. ASC19 explicitly defers forcing/loss-of-control work and leaves part of its desktop/text matrix open. Preserve that exact old scope without declaring today's absence or completion. [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [lead-life rules](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md) and the actual selected [architecture](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md) owners govern current mechanism-first work; this review resumes no Mistglass depth, prototype, old lane or source acquisition.

**Source strengths and gaps stay specific.** Text, fictional speaker, publisher, interpretation, proposal and gap are separated deliberately. A teaser, introduction or sampled public chapter does not qualify a complete ladder, inheritance model, root physiology, realm breakthrough or universal profession restriction. The early Doctor Mo example does not establish trustworthy teachers. “Recessive” translation terminology does not prove Mendelian genetics. Public difficult manuals distinguish acquisition, practice, ceiling and eventual strength. The wishlist's title/edition/chapter targets remain useful consultation leads, not current library gaps or downloads. Source availability, recognition and later exact lore were not freshly verified.

ASC18's actual gap-fill is more limited than “gaps filled”: the RI CSV is largely a claims/Gu-grade ledger with missing master thresholds; Fated Villain's earlier approximately13 bands becomes approximately27 in the later inspected summary; A Will Eternal gains recorded crossings but not all. H labels qualify recorded shape/gates, not primary whole-book certainty. DR1–DR7 are dated, differing screenshots; matching5000 denominators suggests a shared view, not proof that separate snapshots use one live record. The stated MMO launch/store/press observations and guide-only80% threshold retain their date and source class. An adaptation's dailies, SAN, resets or promotion mechanics do not become novel canon or freshly verified game behavior.

**Preserve mechanisms without enforcing balanced sameness.** Capacity, compatibility, expression, proficiency, method, energy, item, institution, rank, quality, quota, readiness and actual grants can differ. The early one active training/support/legacy slot, equal milestone, quality-never-eligibility, compulsory safe retreat, guaranteed repair, no immutable eligibility and no dominant method are original first-slice policies. Actual source/world conditions can grant superiority, impose real irreversible changes, permit multi-method use or supply immediate execution through a faculty/cheat. The heat/ward examples are useful local interactions, not mandatory new meters or universal costs. A breakthrough need not reset a life; each actual transition still declares its effects. [Skill/growth direction](SKILLS_AND_TALENTS.md), [making rules](MAKING_RULES.md) and the selected world decide the relevant mechanism rather than a forced price, weakness, duplicate bar or equal power.

**Ascension is a reusable model, not a completeness theorem.** ASC2's typed crossings and ASC22's four progress dimensions can organize the selected consumer; neither proves every world fits data alone or requires four independent values everywhere. Shared pools, subject-specific Gu/item/companion paths, true capacity versus progress ceiling, and retained provenance are useful. New mechanisms may need narrow handlers and existing owners, not another universal registry. ASC10's blanket no-cross-world effective realm is a proposal qualified by explicit verse equalization and actual conversion means. Destination evaluation does not guarantee foreign weakening. Viewpoint and knowledge constrain what others learn; current own-status and UI owners qualify older uniform felt/unknown-readout suggestions.

**Ritual and persistence scope.** ASC32's Sequence5 statement concerns the sampled promotion requirement, not the absence of every low-Sequence rite, invocation or site operation. A grouped simultaneous crossing is one ritual shape; a staged rite has actual timing, components, consumed inputs and settlement. Wrong invocation need not always create attention or reversible early signs without a source mechanism. Conservation follows actual characteristics/stock and provenance, not merely a label or proposed material owner. Choosing a routine, automatic repetition and an irreversible commitment have their selected current policies; rendered previews or grade labels do not spend, reveal, reroll or confer progress. Existing saved fields, retired states, migration/explicit compatibility, and real native publication remain separate from evaluator output. The old one-prestige milestone is retired. Current AD36/AD43 and optional human review govern evidence, rather than an inherited unrun matrix or fresh budget request.

All original findings, ideas, comparison rows, source limits and delivery history remain. Reopen a named family/ASC/DR row for a selected actual consumer and fresh source/behavior check. This pass edited documentation only, with no primary novel/PDF/image/code audit, runtime test/build/browser, source collection, personal save, deletion, relocation, commit or push.
reviews.evidence: Read all647 pre-fold lines in1–170,171–340,341–490,491–647. No fresh linked novel, Discord image, code, MMO or current behavior verification; all later status/gap-fill qualifiers included.
reviews.reopen: Reopen selected family/ASC/DR row under current mechanism/world priorities, with qualified source and actual delivery evidence; no revived Jade Hollow/Mistglass or legacy lane dispatch.
